about: Modifiers worth more on a Precursor Tablet than the craft you were aiming at — hand-picked, because no price feed lists tablets. The Tablets tab shows each one's odds of turning up while you roll, with a trade search and a box for the price you see. One list for all three tablets: an entry shows on every tablet that can roll all of its modifiers. Two tiers, in Dorian's words: `jackpot` — "doesn't matter what you have on it, if you have one of these it skyrockets"; `good` — the ones that add to what a tablet sells for.

entry.mods: tablet modifier ids, all of which must be on the item at once (data/patches/0.5.0/mods.json)
entry.reads: what each of those modifiers says in game, in the same order. The ids are the game's internal names and can mislead — Tablets/RitualMagicMonsters is the one that reads "chance to be Rare" — so a test holds each id to its text
entry.note: optional — why it is worth having, in the player's words
